{{Top}}
The '''atmospheric processor''', '''atmosphere processor''', or '''atmosphere processing unit''', was an integral part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system.

[[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]] had powerful atmospheric processor units. They allowed the patrons to shed their [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], which were necessary for survival while outside on Reuss VIII.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
